The '''Black Gold beaches''' were the Northern part of the [[Gold Beaches/Legends|Gold Beaches]], on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The name was due to the black [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Silica/Legends|silica]].
